colorSpace: sRGB (THREE.SRGBColorSpace); rendered with Blender AgX, interior lights on

projection.room: x in [0,1] across the window (left->right seen from outside), y in [0,1] floor->ceiling, z in [0,1] into the building; window plane z = 0, back wall z = 1 (baked room: 3 x 3 x 3 m)
projection.camera: pinhole at (0.5, 0.5, -1) looking +z, frustum = the window rectangle at z = 0 (FOV 53.13 deg)
projection.cellUv: uv = 0.5 + (p.xy - 0.5) / (1.0 + p.z)   (p = where the view ray hits the room box)
projection.atlasUv: atlasUv = (vec2(col, ROWS - 1 - row) + cellUv) / vec2(COLS, ROWS)   (three.js flipY = true)
projection.depthScale: a room deeper than the window is wide: divide the ray direction z by depth (1 = as baked)

usage: Emissive-like radiance behind the glass: day x0.35-0.6, night lit x1.0-1.4, night dark x0.03. Pick a cell per window from a hash of the window id + facade class (kind); mirror x for variety.
